You can mix it with language exchange meetups in Lagos for a relaxed social element. That way, you keep it flexible but still build a cool new skill over time.
(b) You could try short daily doodle challenges or quick sketching prompts to sharpen your hand-drawing skills in a fun way. (c) You could join a casual Afrobeats dance class once a week or follow short YouTube tutorials to pick up new moves at home. It’s a great way to connect to Nigerian culture while staying active. That way, you keep it light but still grow a fun and expressive skill set.
(d) You could try short online tutorials in something like photography, cooking, or basic guitar to learn at your own pace. You can fit them into small breaks without feeling tied down. That way, you keep it stress-free but still have something new and interesting to explore.
